name: heart
title: Heart
description: A heart icon with hover scale, a click heartbeat, and an animated fill transition.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the heart outline.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Fill color used when the heart is liked.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the heart outline.

props.name: filled
props.description: Controlled liked state. When omitted the icon manages its own state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called with the next liked state whenever the icon is toggled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the toggle button.

accessibility: Renders as a button with role="button", aria-pressed reflecting the liked state, and an accessible label. Toggles on Enter and Space.
touch: Hover scale is gated behind a (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) check, so it never fires on tap. Tapping toggles the fill directly with a spring press feedback.
reducedMotion: The heartbeat keyframe is skipped; the fill still transitions with a short 150ms ease-out so state change remains perceivable.
